sources.role: Report-card areas, latest OEIF graded inspection, latest ungraded inspection (newest release)
sources.publication: Management information - state-funded schools - latest inspections as at 30 Sep 2026

sources.role: Latest and previous graded inspection including pre-2019 (pre-OEIF) grades; the Sep 2026 release only carries OEIF graded inspections
sources.publication: Management information - state-funded schools - latest inspections as at 31 Dec 2025

legacyFile: data/ofsted-latest.csv is the superseded input of the previous map (undated old-schema extract); not used by the current script

rules.ofstedRating/ofstedDate: Most recent graded overall effectiveness (1 Outstanding, 2 Good, 3 Requires improvement, 4 Inadequate) by inspection start date, across Sep 2026 OEIF graded, Dec 2025 latest graded, Dec 2025 previous graded. ofstedDate is the inspection start date (dd/mm/yyyy), unchanged meaning.
rules.ud/uo: Latest ungraded inspection date and outcome (Sep 2026 release, else Dec 2025), only when later than the graded inspection. uo has the leading 'School ' and trailing ' - S5 Next' removed, e.g. 'remains Good', 'remains Good (Concerns)', 'remains Good (Improving)', 'Standards maintained', 'Improved significantly', 'Some aspects not as strong'.
rules.rc/rcd: Report-card inspection (from Sep 2025), area grades and inspection start date. Not an overall grade. 1 Exceptional, 2 Strong standard, 3 Expected standard, 4 Needs attention, 5 Urgent improvement. sg (safeguarding standards) is 1 Met, 0 Not met.
rules.gx: 1 when the graded inspection was of a predecessor URN (for example before academy conversion).
rules.ot: Ofsted report provider type for the URL https://reports.ofsted.gov.uk/provider/{ot ?? 21}/{urn}: 20 Nursery, 21 Primary (omitted), 22 Alternative provision, 23 Secondary, 25 Special.
